scripts.test:unit:dependencies: node --test packages/modules/待办/tests/*.test.mjs packages/modules/文件/tests/*.test.mjs packages/domain/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n frontend,desktop,phone,packages "npm run lint --workspace console" "npm run lint --workspace desktop" "npm run lint --workspace phone" "npm run lint:packages" && npm run lint --workspace blog
scripts.lint:frontend: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n frontend,desktop,phone "npm run lint --workspace console" "npm run lint --workspace desktop" "npm run lint --workspace phone" && npm run lint --workspace blog
scripts.typecheck: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n frontend,desktop,phone,packages "npm run typecheck --workspace console" "npm run typecheck --workspace desktop" "npm run typecheck --workspace phone" "npm run typecheck:packages" && npm run typecheck --workspace blog
scripts.typecheck:frontend: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n frontend,desktop,phone "npm run typecheck --workspace console" "npm run typecheck --workspace desktop" "npm run typecheck --workspace phone" && npm run typecheck --workspace blog
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint:frontend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace blog && npm run build --workspace console
